records.name: Brigadechefin Schlusswort
records.biography_en: Schlusswort keeps the HyperNorm residents in formation with orders she has not yet unrolled. A card proposing that a decision can remain open receives her most conclusive stare: a matter is either settled or insubordinate. Men in Black admire her firmness. She presses the paper shut, leaving the actual wording free to surprise everybody later.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Beschluss steht fest. Sein Inhalt bleibt zusammengerollt.

variant_notes.note_en: She regards a closed discussion as the first sign of a functioning command.

records.name: Sergeant Atemreserve
records.biography_en: Atemreserve supplies the HyperNorm stairwell with a call whose conclusion is always nearly ready. A card suggesting that silence might also communicate makes his cheeks swell: an assembly is either summoned or absent. Hunky & Dory expect another clear signal. He holds the breath a moment longer, privately enjoying the interval before anyone has to obey.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Aufruf befindet sich noch im zuständigen Atemraum.

variant_notes.note_en: He finds the pause before the next note more reassuring than the order it announces.

records.name: Korporal Erdschwere
records.biography_en: Erdschwere waits in the HyperNorm corridor with the spade already accounted for. A card proposing that progress need not leave a hole earns his heaviest lower lip: ground is either prepared or somebody else's unfinished assignment. Men in Black request a solid foundation. He rests on the shaft while deciding whether their metaphor deserves excavation.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Grundlage wurde angefordert. Das Loch gilt noch als Vorschlag.

variant_notes.note_en: He suspects that every proposed shortcut will eventually require his shovel.

records.name: Leutnantin Einfall
records.biography_en: Einfall maintains the HyperNorm signal station from a doorway that has never afforded a clear view. A card allowing an idea to remain tentative produces a delighted squint: a thought is either announced or wasted. Hunky & Dory praise initiative. She touches her cheek before raising the little flag, briefly keeping one discovery entirely to herself.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Einfall ist eingetroffen. Die Bekanntgabe wartet auf Sichtkontakt.

variant_notes.note_en: She experiences every useful thought as an announcement worth making immediately.

records.name: Rekrut Paradeblick
records.biography_en: Paradeblick presents himself beside the HyperNorm entrance with a weapon held carefully upright. A card suggesting that obedience and understanding are different things receives his proudest lip curl: a recruit is either ready or improperly arranged. Men in Black commend his appearance. He looks sideways for the inspection, hopeful that somebody will finally tell him what readiness is for.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Bereitschaft ist vorzeigbar. Ihr Verwendungszweck folgt.

variant_notes.note_en: He stands ready for the inspection he believes will explain the assignment.

records.name: Korporal Bohnenzorn
records.biography_en: Bohnenzorn defends the HyperNorm morning with an enamel pot and a spoon that has heard every complaint. A card proposing that care can include imperfection receives an outraged look into the brew: coffee is either correct or an insult. Hunky & Dory demand dependable morale. He stirs again, trying to improve something without admitting that improvement was necessary.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Versorgung ist gesichert. Der Geschmack wurde zur Stellungnahme aufgefordert.

variant_notes.note_en: He takes an uncertain brew as a personal challenge to the chain of command.
